translations.web: He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.
translations.bsb: He must not take many wives for himself, lest his heart go astray. He must not accumulate for himself large amounts of silver and gold.
translations.kjv: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.
